title: Grand Theft Astra
tagline: Meet Mara at the Paloma and take the keys to her convertible
description: Last Light at the Paloma opens on foot in Los Pacificos. Mara offers a delivery job with a bonus for keeping her teal Aurora in good condition. Follow the minimap to the convertible and inspect its rear lamp before driving.
features: Third-person exploration of a fictional California coastal city
Captioned mission dialogue and a distance marker for the current objective
Vehicle entry with a dashboard speedometer
